clips.title: The story
paras: Captain Grayson is the restless spirit of a pirate captain stationed at the Westfall Lighthouse. Having lost his own life when his ship smashed against the dark coastline, he now watches over the beacon to prevent other sailors from suffering his fate.

In life, Grayson captained a vessel along the perilous southern seas of the Eastern Kingdoms. His voyage came to a violent end off the jagged shoals of Westfall on a night when the lighthouse fire had gone dark. Cast upon the rocks, Grayson perished alongside his ship, only to awaken as an earthbound phantom trapped upon the coast.

Drawn to the Westfall Lighthouse in death, Grayson hoped to find answers about the afterlife. Instead, he witnessed sheer tragedy. A notorious murloc known as Old Murk-Eye drove the lighthouse keeper and his family away. Though the keepers bravely returned to rekindle the flame, Old Murk-Eye rallied the surrounding murlocs for a second, brutal slaughter. Grayson could only watch helplessly as the family was butchered.

With the keepers dead and Westfall crumbling under neglect, Captain Grayson took the solemn burden of the beacon upon his spectral shoulders. He seeks aid from passing adventurers to gather fuel for the great flame and avenge the slaughtered family by hunting down Old Murk-Eye and driving back the coastal murloc tide.
